markImageDescriptions.markImageDescription: The mark consists of the white stylized wording "MIFARE" overlaid on three overlapping circles. The larger central circle is blue with three white partial concentric rings. The two smaller circles appear on the right and left side of the larger circle. The circle on the left side is orange. The circle on the right side is green. The white background is not part of the mark.
